title: SolutionViewer: call the PreStepUserFunction before a step is drawn, with callPreStepUserFunction
author: Claude-JG
description: Often helpful if the SolutionViewer called mbs.PreStepUserFunction before rendering a step - graphical animation, prescribed control values updated in the frames; a flag callPreStepUserFunction=True/False, False by default, called after SetSolutionState with the time of the row; an example: a ground brick with its frame moving along a screw, its referenceHT set as exu.HT in a PreStepUserFunction
releaseNotes: SolutionViewer(..., callPreStepUserFunction=True) calls the PreStepUserFunction with the time of each shown step before it is drawn; example solutionViewerPreStepUserFunction.py. revision2026c step RG6.18
